demo-003.threat_explanation: Volume shadow copies are backups that allow restoring files. Attackers (especially ransomware) delete them to prevent the victim from recovering their files without paying the ransom.

demo-003.attack_impact: Irreversible file encryption threat, system recovery mechanism destruction, persistent denial of local backup data.
demo-003.severity_assessment: Maximum severity rule level 15 triggered because shadow copy deletion combined with bcdedit recovery disablement is a signature pre-encryption step.
